original_scenario.question: Keep contradictory stratigraphic assertions visible
original_scenario.sql: SELECT a.id,b.id FROM stratigraphic_assertions a JOIN stratigraphic_assertions b ON a.source_context_id=b.target_context_id AND a.target_context_id=b.source_context_id WHERE a.id<b.id

original_scenario.question: Overlapping interpretations keep both authors and evidence
original_scenario.sql: SELECT a.author,b.author FROM interpretations a JOIN interpretations b ON a.context_id=b.context_id AND a.id<b.id WHERE a.earliest<=b.latest AND b.earliest<=a.latest

original_scenario.question: One square drawing depicts two contexts
original_scenario.sql: SELECT asset_id,COUNT(DISTINCT context_id) FROM asset_subjects GROUP BY asset_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT context_id)>1

original_scenario.question: External assets are not falsely included
original_scenario.sql: SELECT id FROM assets WHERE availability='external'

original_scenario.question: NISP, MNI, sherds and vessels keep distinct denominators
original_scenario.sql: SELECT f.nisp,f.mni,p.sherd_count,p.estimated_vessels FROM fauna_results f JOIN analyses a ON a.id=f.analysis_id JOIN samples s ON s.id=a.sample_id JOIN find_lots l ON l.context_id=s.context_id JOIN objects o ON o.lot_id=l.id JOIN pottery_results p ON p.object_id=o.id

original_scenario.question: Find-to-context chain is retained
original_scenario.sql: SELECT o.id,c.native_locus FROM objects o JOIN find_lots l ON l.id=o.lot_id JOIN contexts c ON c.id=l.context_id

original_scenario.question: Interpretations retain resolved specialist evidence alongside native source literals
original_scenario.sql: SELECT i.author,p.form,f.taxon FROM interpretations i JOIN interpretation_evidence e ON e.interpretation_id=i.id LEFT JOIN pottery_results p ON p.id=e.pottery_result_id LEFT JOIN fauna_results f ON f.id=e.fauna_result_id ORDER BY i.id

original_scenario.question: Subsample lineage and soil preparation remain explicit
original_scenario.sql: SELECT s.parent_id,r.preparation FROM samples s JOIN analyses a ON a.sample_id=s.parent_id JOIN soil_results r ON r.analysis_id=a.id WHERE s.parent_id IS NOT NULL

original_scenario.question: Occurrence and sampling effort share actual survey event
original_scenario.sql: SELECT o.id FROM occurrences o JOIN effort e ON e.id=o.effort_id WHERE e.event_id<>o.event_id

original_scenario.question: Two connected reaches retain temperature and dissolved oxygen with probe methods
original_scenario.sql: SELECT p.name,COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) FROM observations o JOIN observed_properties p ON p.id=o.property_id JOIN samples s ON s.id=o.sample_id JOIN sampling_events e ON e.id=s.event_id JOIN monitoring_sites ms ON ms.id=e.site_id JOIN reaches r ON r.id=ms.reach_id JOIN methods m ON m.id=e.method_id WHERE p.name IN ('temperature','dissolved-oxygen') AND m.fraction='in-situ' GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY p.name

original_scenario.question: Below-detection nitrate is not zero
original_scenario.sql: SELECT id,threshold,qualifier FROM observations WHERE result_kind='censored' AND value IS NULL

original_scenario.question: Coordinate-only match stays unresolved
original_scenario.sql: SELECT id FROM site_matches WHERE resolution='unresolved'

original_scenario.question: Exclude effort-unknown detection from quantitative comparison
original_scenario.sql: SELECT o.id FROM occurrences o JOIN effort e ON e.id=o.effort_id WHERE e.amount IS NULL

original_scenario.question: Known-effort non-detection is distinct from missing occurrence
original_scenario.sql: SELECT o.id FROM occurrences o JOIN effort e ON e.id=o.effort_id WHERE o.count=0 AND o.detection='not-detected' AND e.amount IS NOT NULL

original_scenario.question: Matrix, fraction and taxonomy rank are retained
original_scenario.sql: SELECT DISTINCT m.matrix,m.fraction,t.rank FROM occurrences o JOIN sampling_events e ON e.id=o.event_id JOIN methods m ON m.id=e.method_id JOIN identifications i ON i.id=o.identification_id JOIN taxa t ON t.id=i.taxon_id
